content:
At forty, Veronica Hale believes love has passed her by. Divorced, childless, and emotionally bruised, she lives quietly with her parents until her mother pushes her to start over. Reluctantly, Veronica moves out and rebuilds her life, landing a job at a prestigious fashion company. Her world shifts when she discovers the CEO is Sandra Lawson, a former college friend whose relationship with Veronica ended in misunderstanding years ago. As Veronica settles into her new role, she meets Ethan Lawson, Sandra’s twenty-five-year-old son, brilliant, charming, and dangerously irresistible. What begins as harmless attraction evolves into a forbidden love neither of them planned. The age gap, workplace hierarchy, and family ties threaten to tear them apart. When their secret relationship is exposed, Veronica sacrifices everything and disappears from Ethan’s life carrying a secret of her own. Years later, fate reunites them. Ethan learns the truth about the daughter he never knew existed, Tessy. Hurt and anger give way to understanding as love proves stronger than fear, time, and judgment. In the end, families are forced to confront their biases, and Veronica finally learns that love has no expiration date.
